title: Dexcom G6 / 8G Sensor:  InvalidRxMessage FF0601
symptom: xDrip stops receiving values from a Dexcom G6 8G sensor, showing InvalidRxMessage FF0601 in the log, while the Dexcom receiver still works. The issue occurs after about a day and is temporarily fixed by forgetting the device and restarting the collector.
fix: The issue was resolved after a nightly update from December; it only reappeared briefly after an update and fixed itself after another reading. Manual workaround includes forgetting the device and restarting the collector.
evidence_quote: After a nightly from december the issue is gone. It only happend right after an update again, but fixed itself after another reading.
